data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Mahtob means 'hope' or 'desire'. It is a name deeply rooted in the spiritual traditions of Islam, symbolizing the human longing for the divine and the hope for salvation. The name Mahtob is mentioned in Hadith as being the name of a righteous woman who was promised Paradise for her unwavering faith. The name Mahtob carries the meaning “Hope, Desire” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mahtob usually hope their child will grow to embody hope, desire and live with faith, good character and purpose.
